Why we design with fewer materials

Restraint as a design principle.

IIngrid Lim12 March 2026

Good writing starts with a clear question. In this article we explore the idea in plain language, with examples you can use straight away.

The first thing to understand is that small decisions compound. Choosing carefully at the start saves far more time than it costs, and it makes every later step easier.

We have tested these approaches with real clients over several years. Some worked immediately; others needed adjusting. Here is what we learned.

Three things to remember

  • Start with the outcome you want.
  • Test small before you commit.
  • Write down what you learn.

FAQ

Answers to the questions we hear most.

How many projects do you take on?

Eight a year, so every project has a senior designer throughout.

Do you work on small spaces?

Yes. Some of our favourite projects are under 800 sq ft.

What is your style?

Quiet, natural and edited, with warm woods, linen and plenty of light.

Can you work with a contractor I already have?

Of course. We can design only, or manage the build as well.

How long does a project take?

A typical home takes four to six months from first visit to handover.

Do you work outside KL?

Yes, across Malaysia and Singapore.
